info.name: Apache Software Foundation Get Foundation Groups

items.docs: Returns a JSON object containing all ASF groups (PMCs, committees, and other organizational groups) and their members.

info.name: Apache Software Foundation Get All Committees

items.docs: Returns a JSON object containing information about all ASF Project Management Committees (PMCs), including chair, description, homepage, and roster.

info.name: Apache Software Foundation Get All Projects

items.docs: Returns a JSON object containing metadata for all ASF top-level projects, including name, description, category, PMC, programming language, and repository information.

info.name: Apache Software Foundation Get All Releases

items.docs: Returns a JSON object containing release information for all ASF projects, including version numbers and release dates.

info.name: Apache Software Foundation Get All Podlings

items.docs: Returns a JSON object containing information about all ASF Incubator podlings, including their status (current, graduated, retired), start date, sponsor, mentors, and description.
Returns a JSON object mapping ASF member usernames to the list of committees and groups they belong to.

info.name: Apache Software Foundation Get People Names

items.docs: Returns a JSON object mapping ASF member usernames to their display names.
